description: Source code for a dependency verification tool in Kubernetes, managing unwanted dependencies, pinned modules, and vendored modules, with functions for running commands, parsing module graphs, and checking for dependency violations.

classes.name: Unwanted
classes.description: Struct representing unwanted dependencies and their status.

classes.name: UnwantedSpec
classes.description: Specifying unwanted modules and pinned modules with reasons.

classes.name: PinnedModule
classes.description: Details of a pinned module including version and reason.

classes.name: UnwantedStatus
classes.description: Status of unwanted dependencies including references and vendored modules.

classes.name: module
classes.description: Represents a Go module with name and version.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Runs a command and returns combined stdout and stderr.

methods.name: runCommandInDir
methods.description: Runs a command in a specified directory.

methods.name: readFile

methods.name: moduleInSlice

methods.name: difference

methods.name: main
